Careers

/Mission

Proteins are the most advanced nanotechnology we know of. At Adaptyv, our mission is to make proteins easier to engineer. We are building technologies that allow protein engineers to design and test new proteins in order to develop new medicines, better enzymes for research and industrial application or functional materials with novel properties. We are building an extraordinary team of talented engineers with backgrounds in synthetic biology, lab automation, software engineering and machine learning. If you want to develop revolutionary technologies then come work with us at Adaptyv Bio.

/Core Values

First Principles Thinking

We break down complex problems into their fundamental components and develop innovative solutions by questioning assumptions and challenging the status quo.

Data-driven Engineering

We use data to make decisions and we build technology to generate new data to help us engineer biology better.

Action-oriented Mindset

We value a proactive and results-driven mindset. We prioritize getting things done, taking risks, and learning from our successes and failures to constantly improve and adapt.

Strong Work Ethic

We want to make a difference and create something fundamentally new. Everyone on our team is working very hard to make that happen and we're looking for people who share this drive.
